settings.title: Settings
settings.policyEasy: knocks at {{knockLimit}} deadwood or less / takes the discard 1 time in {{easyOneIn}}
settings.policyNormal: knocks at {{knockNormal}} or less / takes the discard when it gains more than {{gainNormal}}
settings.policyHard: knocks at {{knockHard}} or less, or on gin / takes the discard on any gain
settings.policyTooltip: Difficulty changes when the CPU knocks and when it takes the discard. Numbers are deadwood points.

drawPhase: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile
layoffPhase: Lay off cards onto the knocker's melds

hint.drawFromDiscard: Draw from the discard pile — it fits your hand
hint.knockNow: Knock — your deadwood is low enough
hint.layoffCards: Lay off cards onto the knocker's melds
hint.skipLayoff: No cards fit the knocker's melds — skip

tutorial.drawArea: Draw a card from the stock pile or discard pile.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Form melds (sets of 3+ cards) to reduce deadwood.
tutorial.discardButton: Discard one card from your hand.
tutorial.knockButton: Knock when your deadwood is low. Gin means zero deadwood.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.
